title: 2026-08-05 论文推荐
description: 9 篇推荐：ATFlash: Per-RoPE-Wavelength Attention Windows (东京大学, 按RoPE波长剪枝注意力计算)、Cross-Model KV Cache Transfer (NVIDIA, 跨模型KV缓存线性映射)、AnchorKV (Technion, 20倍KV缓存压缩)、Speculative Correction (NUS, 扩散语言模型先草稿后精修)、Approximate Speculative Decoding (北大, 无训练投机解码加速)、Agentic RL with Self-Distilled Reward Shaping (中科院, LLM Agent token级信用分配)、Maglev (清华, 滑动循环记忆Transformer)、AcceptMoE (Imperial College, MoE投机解码专家选择)、Sphere Retraction Normalizations (台湾中山大学, 球面残差连接统一框架)
